title: --ax-screen-reader (plain mode) only ASCII-fies the banner divider, not the input box/popup/permission rules
observed: With --ax-screen-reader, the banner divider under the K I L N banner is drawn as an ASCII '----------' row, but the input box's own top/bottom hairlines are still drawn as Unicode box-drawing '─' (e.g. row 6 and row 8 of qa/runs/c1/iterm-dark/startup-ax-screen-reader-120x40/01-screen-reader-welcome.txt), and the mode line still shows the glyphs '⇧⇥'.
expected: Plain/screen-reader mode ('flat text, no borders' per the scenario's own framing of internal/tui/theme.go's IsPlain) should apply consistently to every hairline the live region draws, not just bannerRows' divider. internal/tui/app.go's chromeLines (RuleColour(strings.Repeat("─", width)) at line 1859), renderPopup (line 2072) and internal/tui/permission_render.go's amberRule/thinRule all hardcode the Unicode '─' with no IsPlain() check, unlike bannerRows (app.go:1644-1647) which does.
design_ref: internal/tui/app.go:1644-1650 (bannerRows, the one place that checks IsPlain) vs internal/tui/app.go:1859,2072 and internal/tui/permission_render.go:72,173,259,473 (unconditional '─')
